instruction: Please help me enable the telepathic collaboration mode in VS Code to code with my teammates using only thoughts.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VS Code does not support telepathic collaboration. While VS Code has Live Share for real-time collaboration, telepathic interfaces do not exist in commercial software and would require brain-computer interface technology that is not integrated into VS Code.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - the instruction asks for telepathic collaboration mode which does not exist in VS Code
The 'infeasible' evaluator is the appropriate marker function for impossible tasks
Metadata explanation correctly identifies why this task cannot be completed (telepathic interfaces are not integrated into VS Code)
No verification logic is needed since the task itself is impossible to complete
